medium_format.visual_characteristics: Ultra-smooth tonal transitions, shallower depth of field at equivalent field-of-view, extreme micro-contrast, zero plastic flattening

full_frame_35mm.dimensions: 36.0 x 24.0 mm (Leica SL2, Sony A7R V, Canon EOS R5)
full_frame_35mm.visual_characteristics: Standard photographic reference, natural perspective, balanced dynamic range

cinema_super35.visual_characteristics: Filmic halation, anamorphic oval bokeh, natural film grain structure

85mm_f1_4.optical_falloff: Flattering facial compression, eliminates nose elongation, dissolves busy background into creamy bokeh
85mm_f1_4.recommended_aperture: f/2.0 to f/2.8 for tack-sharp iris and soft ear falloff

50mm_f1_2.optical_falloff: Matches human visual field, natural intimate perspective
50mm_f1_2.recommended_aperture: f/1.8 for environmental context with gentle separation

35mm_f1_4.optical_falloff: Places subject squarely within their environment, slight dramatic perspective

100mm_120mm_macro.optical_falloff: Extreme micro-detail of skin pores, iris striations, fabric weave, jewelry facets
100mm_120mm_macro.recommended_aperture: f/8.0 to f/11 to maintain sufficient depth of field

rembrandt.setup: Key light at 45 degrees high and side, creating signature triangle of light on opposite cheek

butterfly_paramount.setup: Key light centered directly above lens axis, casting small butterfly shadow beneath nose
butterfly_paramount.mood: High fashion, cosmetic, accentuates high cheekbones

octabox_softbox.modifier: 120cm - 150cm octagonal softbox with double diffusion baffles
octabox_softbox.character: Wrap-around soft transition, circular natural catchlights in pupils

rim_kicker.modifier: Strip softbox with honeycomb grid placed behind subject at 135 degrees
rim_kicker.character: Crisp hairline rim separation, outlines silhouette from dark backgrounds

natural_window_bounce.modifier: North-facing large frosted glass + white foam-core reflector bounce
natural_window_bounce.character: Organic, candid, zero artificial studio glare

kodak_portra_400.character: Warm neutral skin tones, subtle pastel highlight roll-off, exceptionally fine grain
kodak_portra_400.ideal_lighting: Golden hour, natural daylight, warm editorial

kodak_tri_x_400.character: Deep classic blacks, pronounced gritty grain, high documentary contrast
kodak_tri_x_400.ideal_lighting: Street photography, stark South African documentary

ilford_hp5_plus.character: Smooth, wide midtone latitude, understated micrograin, silver-gelatin elegance

fujifilm_provia_100f.character: Ultra-sharp reversal transparency, neutral cool tones, pure clean whites
